coreResponsibility: A Kaltura Player engine plugin that enables document-type media playback (PDFs, presentations, documents) within the Kaltura Player ecosystem, rendering document thumbnails with optional timed playback support for playlists.

featureOwnership: Non-durational document mode (static display without seek bar)
Durational document mode (timed playback with seek bar for playlists)
Document preview functionality via configurable preview URL
Fullscreen support with dynamic thumbnail quality upgrade
Timer-based playback simulation for timed documents
Playback rate control for timed documents
dataHandling: Document source URL and thumbnail URL management
Timer state machine for simulated playback (currentTime, duration, playbackRate)
Kaltura session (ks) parameter injection for authenticated document access
Document entry metadata (name, id, thumbnailUrl, downloadUrl)
Playback events dispatching (PLAY, PAUSE, TIME_UPDATE, ENDED, SEEKED, etc.)

upstream: Kaltura Backend API (document entry retrieval, thumbnail service)
downstream: Kaltura Player V7 web player applications
Kaltura MediaSpace and KAF (Kaltura Application Framework)
Custom player integrations using Kaltura Player JS SDK
Playlist playback scenarios requiring document entries
externalApis: Kaltura Session API (ks parameter for authentication)

entryPoints.description: Main entry point - registers the document player plugin with Kaltura Player
Core plugin class (PlaykitJsDocumentPlugin) - manages plugin lifecycle, UI components, and engine registration
Document playback engine (DocumentPlayerEngine) - implements IEngine interface for document rendering and playback simulation
Timer utility class - handles timed document playback with seek, rate control, and time updates
Document overlay UI component - displays preview/download buttons and document name

errorPatterns: The document thumbnail failed to load

configurationOptions.basePreviewUrl: URL prefix for document preview (opens in new tab)
configurationOptions.downloadDisabled: Boolean to enable/disable document download functionality (default: true)
